# Leif GW Persson: ”Jag har åkt på en del fetingar”

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-10-07  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Börsmorgon interviews criminologist and author Leif GW Persson about his personal investing. Most of his money is in unlisted holdings, and almost all of his roughly SEK 30-40m in listed shares sits in the gaming company EG7, which he calls hugely undervalued at a P/E of 2.4 against an industry average of 8-10. He is cautious about the wider market because of world events, avoids AI and US tech stocks he says he does not understand, and stays away from medtech after heavy losses and from money-gambling companies such as Evolution on ethical grounds.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 EG7 — EG7 | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Guest (Leif GW Persson) calls EG7 hugely undervalued at P/E 2.4 vs sector 8-10, keeps adding (bought yesterday) and holds despite a current loss.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion, not the hosts'. A valuation-gap thesis: P/E 2.4 against a sector average of 8-10. He also believes in structural demand for mobile and adventure gaming among young people, and thinks the business is less exposed to geopolitical risk. He has strong personal conviction, with most of his listed portfolio in this one stock and fresh buying. The stock has fallen recently and his position is in the red. Concentration risk and his self-admitted gaming unfamiliarity weaken this as an inde

#### Sell Triggers

- if the low P/E reflects falling earnings rather than mispricing
- if the gaming portfolio underdelivers on profitability
- if the guest reduces or exits his position

> *"De är våldsamt undervärderade och jag begriper inte varför. Räkna kan jag. De värderas till ett P-tal på 2,4. Och branschsnittet ligger på 8-10."*

---

### 🟠 SWED-A — Swedbank | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Guest day-trades Swedbank around reports for short-term moves, not as a long-term view.

#### Reasoning

Guest uses Swedbank, and similarly Handelsbanken, as a trading vehicle because of their cyclical price swings. He made SEK 100k buying before a report. He gives no fundamental directional view, only an opportunistic short-term trade 'om läget är det rätta'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the report reaction goes against the position
- if volatility around reports fades

> *"Då kan man hålla på med att daytrada Swedbank om läget är det rätta."*

---

### ⛔ EVO — Evolution | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Guest avoids money-gambling stocks such as Evolution for ethical reasons (gambling addiction), while admitting this cost him financially.

#### Reasoning

This is an ethical exclusion, not a valuation view. The guest avoids companies tied to money gambling because of addiction and crime links, and he praises Evolution's management. It reflects his personal investment policy, not a bearish call on fundamentals.

> *"De som håller på med pengar går jag inte in i av det enkla skälet att de... Det är ju det här med spelmissbruk som är ett väldigt stort problem för många."*

---
